docs.title: Delete Your BoardBound Account
docs.heading: Delete Your BoardBound Account
docs.desc: Instructions for deleting your BoardBound account and associated data.
docs.body: How to request account and data deletion · Martin Apps LLC BoardBound supports complete account and data deletion at any time. You can delete your account directly from within the app, or send a deletion request by email if you no longer have access to the app. This action is permanent. Once deleted, your study history, AI tutor conversations, progress data, and account credentials are removed from our servers and cannot be recovered.

docs.heading: Method 1 — Delete from within the app (recommended)
docs.body: Open BoardBound. Sign in if you are not already signed in. Tap the Settings tab. Scroll to the Account section. Tap Delete Account. Confirm the deletion when prompted. Your account and all associated data are removed from our servers immediately. You'll be signed out and returned to the welcome screen.

docs.heading: Method 2 — Email request
docs.body: If you have uninstalled the app, lost access to your sign-in method, or otherwise cannot use Method 1, send a deletion request to: Email: privacy@martinapps.dev Subject: Account deletion request Please include in the body of your email: The email address you used to sign up for BoardBound. If you signed in with Apple or Google instead of email, the name on that account. A brief statement confirming you want your account and all associated data deleted. We process email-based deletion requests within 7 business days. We may reply asking you to confirm the request from the email address tied to your account, to prevent unauthorized deletion.

docs.heading: What gets deleted
docs.body: When you delete your BoardBound account, the following data is permanently removed from our servers: Your email address and account credentials All practice answer history and study progress Spaced-repetition review schedules AI tutor conversation history Daily streak and exam target settings Crash report records associated with your account Data that is not stored on our servers is also removed when you uninstall the app: Locally cached question content (lives only on your device) Device-local AI tutor consent record

docs.heading: What happens to my subscription?
docs.body: Account deletion does not automatically cancel your subscription. Subscriptions are managed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Play Store) and must be canceled separately: iOS: Open the iOS Settings app → tap your name → Subscriptions → BoardBound → Cancel Subscription. Android: Open the Google Play Store app → tap your profile picture → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions → BoardBound → Cancel. If you delete your account while a subscription is still active, you will continue to be charged at each renewal date until you cancel through Apple or Google. Refunds for unused subscription time are handled by Apple and Google according to their respective policies.

docs.heading: Recovering after deletion
docs.body: Once your account is deleted, the data cannot be recovered. If you wish to use BoardBound again in the future, you will need to create a new account. Your previous study history will not be restored.

docs.heading: Questions
docs.body: For privacy-related questions, contact privacy@martinapps.dev. For all other support, see our Support page or email support@martinapps.dev. For details on how we handle your data, see our Privacy Policy. © 2026 Martin Apps LLC · Alabama, United States · Home · Privacy · Support · Terms

docs.title: BoardBound Privacy Policy
docs.heading: BoardBound Privacy Policy
docs.desc: The BoardBound privacy policy: how the app handles your information, and your choices. From Martin Apps LLC.
docs.body: Effective date: April 10, 2026 · Last updated: November 6, 2026 BoardBound ("the App") is operated by Martin Apps LLC, an Alabama limited liability company ("we," "us," or "our"). This policy describes what data we collect, why we collect it, how we protect it, and the choices you have. BoardBound is an educational exam preparation tool for Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) board certification. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. BoardBound is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to AANPCB or ANCC.

docs.heading: Account Information
docs.body: When you create an account, we collect: Email address and password (for email signup; the password is stored as a cryptographic hash only, never in plain text), or Name and email provided by Apple (for Sign in with Apple — you may choose Apple's private relay email to hide your real address) Display name (optional, user-provided)

docs.heading: Study Profile
docs.body: During onboarding you provide: Exam target (AANP, ANCC, or both) Expected exam date (optional) Expected graduation date (optional)

docs.heading: Study Progress
docs.body: As you use the App, we record: Questions answered, selected answers, and correctness Time spent per question Study mode (practice, exam simulation, daily quiz) Spaced repetition scheduling data (review intervals, ease factors) Accuracy statistics by clinical domain Study streaks and last study date The days on which you answered at least one question: the date only (no time of day, answers or scores), stored on our servers with your account

docs.heading: AI Tutor Interactions (opt-in only)
docs.body: Before your first AI Tutor interaction, the App shows a consent screen that lists exactly what will be sent to Anthropic. The AI Tutor is disabled until you accept. You can revoke consent at any time in Settings. If you consent, we process: The question text and answer options Your selected answer, the correct answer, and the stored clinical rationale Your exam target (AANP/ANCC/both), to personalize explanations Your messages to the AI Tutor and its responses (stored as conversation history) Daily and monthly interaction counts (for rate limiting) Token usage per session (for cost tracking) AI responses you flag as clinically inaccurate (logged so we can review and correct them) Important: Never enter personal health information (PHI) or real patient data into the AI Tutor. The AI Tutor is for educational exam preparation only. Rate limits. Free accounts are limited to 3 AI Tutor interactions per day. All accounts (free and paid) are capped at 800 interactions per month. These limits protect you and us from runaway usage. Architecture. Our Anthropic API key is never stored in the mobile app. All AI Tutor requests are proxied through our Supabase Edge Function, which adds authentication, rate limiting, and usage tracking before forwarding the request to Anthropic.

docs.heading: Subscription Information
docs.body: If you subscribe, Apple processes your payment. We receive from our subscription provider (RevenueCat): Subscription status and tier (free, monthly, or sprint) Expiration date A RevenueCat customer identifier We do not receive or store your payment method, credit card number, or Apple ID password. Apple handles all billing.

docs.heading: Crash Reports
docs.body: If the App crashes, our error reporting service (Sentry) automatically collects: Error type, stack trace, and breadcrumbs (actions leading to the crash) Device model, operating system version, and app version Crash reports do not include your user ID, email address, IP address, study answers, or AI Tutor messages. Sentry is configured so crash data is not linked to your account.

docs.heading: Data We Do Not Collect
docs.body: Location data Contacts, photos, or camera access Health or fitness data Advertising identifiers (IDFA) or cross-app tracking Browsing or search history

docs.heading: 2. How We Use Your Data
docs.body: Data Purpose Account info Authenticate you and sync your progress across devices Study profile Personalize your study plan and daily question targets Study progress Track performance, power spaced repetition, and show accuracy breakdowns. Study days are also counted in aggregate (how many accounts studied, and on how many days) so we can tell whether the App keeps people studying; they are not used for advertising or shared outside our service providers AI Tutor data Generate personalized explanations via the Anthropic Claude API (proxied through our Edge Function) Flagged AI responses Review and correct clinically inaccurate AI output Subscription info Determine your access tier and enforce usage limits Crash reports Diagnose and fix bugs We do not sell your data. We do not use your data for advertising. We do not build marketing profiles. We do not share data with data brokers.

docs.heading: 3. Third-Party Services
docs.body: We share data with the following service providers, solely for the purposes described: Service Purpose Data Shared Privacy Policy Supabase Authentication, database, Edge Functions Account info, study progress, AI tutor sessions supabase.com/privacy Anthropic AI Tutor (Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4) — opt-in only, proxied via our Edge Function Question text, your answer, correct answer, expert rationale, conversation messages, exam target anthropic.com/privacy RevenueCat Subscription management User identifier, subscription status revenuecat.com/privacy Sentry Crash reporting (not linked to user identity) Error traces, device info, app version sentry.io/privacy Apple Sign in with Apple, app distribution, in-app purchase processing Apple-managed identity token; billing handled by Apple apple.com/legal/privacy Each provider has its own privacy policy governing how it handles data it receives from BoardBound. Anthropic does not use API inputs to train its models.

docs.heading: 4. Data Storage and Security
docs.body: Local storage: Study progress and spaced repetition data are stored on your device in a local SQLite database. Authentication tokens are stored securely in the iOS Keychain via Apple's Secure Store. Cloud storage: Your account, profile, and progress data are stored in Supabase (hosted on AWS). All data is isolated by user via row-level security (RLS) policies — no user can access another user's data. In transit: All data is transmitted over HTTPS/TLS. Server-side safeguards: The AI Tutor Edge Function performs authentication, input validation, and rate limiting before forwarding any request to Anthropic. No API keys on device: The Anthropic API key exists only as a server-side secret on Supabase. It is not present in the mobile app binary. No system is perfectly secure. If we discover a breach affecting your data, we will notify you consistent with applicable law.

docs.heading: 5. Data Retention
docs.body: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account (Settings > Delete Account), all your data is permanently removed from our servers. Profile data, study progress, AI tutor sessions, flagged responses, and usage records are deleted via cascading database deletion from the authentication record. Local data (on-device database and Keychain entries) is cleared at the time of account deletion. Some data may remain in routine encrypted backups for up to 30 days before being purged on our normal backup rotation. Crash reports in Sentry are retained for 90 days. Anthropic may retain AI Tutor inputs in accordance with their privacy policy. Anthropic does not use API inputs to train models.

docs.heading: 6. Your Rights
docs.body: You can: Access your data at any time within the App (Settings, Progress screens) Edit your display name, exam target, and exam date in Settings Revoke AI Tutor consent at any time in Settings, which stops all data sharing with Anthropic Delete your account in Settings, which permanently removes all your data Request a data export by contacting us at the email below To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@martinapps.dev from the address on your account. We respond within 30 days.

docs.heading: 7. International Data Transfers
docs.body: BoardBound is operated from the United States. Your data is processed and stored in the United States by our service providers (Supabase, Anthropic, RevenueCat, Sentry). If you are located outside the United States, your data will be transferred to the U.S. for processing. By using the App, you consent to this transfer. For users in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom, these transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, or equivalent safeguards maintained by our service providers, to protect your data in accordance with EU/UK data protection law.

docs.heading: 8. Legal Basis for Processing (EEA/UK Users)
docs.body: If you are in the European Economic Area or United Kingdom, we process your data under the following legal bases: Contractual necessity: Account creation, study progress tracking, and subscription management — required to provide the service Consent: AI Tutor data sharing with Anthropic — you explicitly opt in via the in-app consent screen and can revoke at any time Legitimate interest: Crash reporting and error diagnosis — necessary to maintain app quality and stability You may exercise your rights under GDPR (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection) by contacting us at the email below.

docs.heading: 9. California Privacy Rights
docs.body: If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) provides you with additional rights: Right to Know: You may request the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected Right to Delete: You may request deletion of your personal information (available in Settings > Delete Account) Right to Correct: You may request correction of inaccurate personal information Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your CCPA rights We do not sell personal information. We do not share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@martinapps.dev.

docs.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
docs.body: BoardBound is intended for adult nursing students preparing for board certification, and you must be at least 18 years old to create an account (see our Terms of Use). Its App Store age rating describes the app's content, not who may use it. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has created an account, please contact us and we will delete it.

docs.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
docs.body: We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you via the App or email before the changes take effect. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the App after the effective date of an updated policy constitutes acceptance.

docs.heading: 12. Contact
docs.body: For privacy questions, data requests, or concerns: Email: privacy@martinapps.dev Martin Apps LLC, Alabama, United States © 2026 Martin Apps LLC. All rights reserved.

docs.title: BoardBound Support
docs.heading: BoardBound Support
docs.desc: Get help with BoardBound, the FNP board-exam study app, or contact Martin Apps support.
docs.body: BoardBound Prep · AI-powered FNP board exam preparation BoardBound Prep is an educational study aid for nurse practitioner students preparing for AANP and ANCC Family Nurse Practitioner board certification. It pairs a curated question bank with an AI tutor that explains clinical reasoning like a real NP preceptor. Need help? Email us at support@martinapps.dev and we'll respond within one business day.

docs.heading: How do I restore a previous purchase?
docs.body: Open the app and head to Settings → Restore Purchases. You can tap "Restore Purchases" on the paywall screen too. Your subscription is tied to your Apple ID, so make sure you're signed in with the same Apple ID you originally used to subscribe.

docs.heading: How do I cancel my subscription?
docs.body: Apple manages subscriptions. Go to Settings → Manage Subscription in the app, or open Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions on your device. You can cancel anytime and keep access until your current billing period ends.

docs.heading: How do I delete my account and data?
docs.body: In the app, go to Settings → Delete Account. This permanently deletes your account, study history, progress data, and any AI tutor conversations from our servers. You cannot undo this. If you have an active subscription, cancel it through Apple first to avoid continued billing.

docs.heading: Is the AI tutor safe to use?
docs.body: The AI tutor is limited to the fixed rationale stored with each question. It explains that rationale — it does not generate its own clinical facts, and it does not answer from open-ended general knowledge. Questions and rationales are AI-generated and machine-audited; a licensed clinician has not reviewed them. Every response has an educational-use disclaimer, and every response includes a "Flag for Clinical Inaccuracy" button so you can report anything that seems wrong. AI tutor access requires an explicit opt-in consent screen that names Anthropic as the AI provider.

docs.heading: Should I enter patient information into the AI tutor?
docs.body: No. Never enter personal health information (PHI) or real patient data into the AI tutor. BoardBound is for exam preparation only and is not a clinical tool.

docs.heading: How many questions are included?
docs.body: BoardBound has 500+ questions covering both the AANP and ANCC FNP exam blueprints, each tagged to a blueprint domain and citing the clinical guideline it rests on. Questions and rationales are AI-generated and machine-audited; a licensed clinician has not reviewed them. Users on the free tier can practice 30 questions a day. Paid subscribers get unlimited access to the full question bank.

docs.heading: What exam formats are supported?
docs.body: Questions are tagged to the official exam blueprints for both AANP FNP (Assess, Diagnose, Plan, Evaluate) and ANCC FNP-BC (Assessment, Diagnosis, Planning, Implementation, Evaluation). You choose your target exam during onboarding.

docs.heading: Is BoardBound affiliated with AANPCB or ANCC?
docs.body: No. BoardBound Prep is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (AANPCB) or the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC).

docs.heading: Contact
docs.body: For support inquiries, feedback, or to report an issue: Email: support@martinapps.dev Privacy questions: privacy@martinapps.dev For privacy details, see our Privacy Policy. For terms of use, see our Terms of Service. © 2026 Martin Apps LLC. BoardBound Prep is an educational tool. It is not medical advice.

docs.body: Retold for iOS · Last updated November 16, 2026

docs.heading: Overview
docs.body: Retold helps you keep the stories of your life in your own voice. It records what you say, writes down the words on your iPhone, and keeps each memory with its recording. Retold collects no personal data. Everything stays on your iPhone unless you choose to export it. In short: no account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking, and no servers. The only network request Retold makes is the optional Better transcripts download described below, and it sends none of your data.

docs.heading: Data Collection
docs.body: Retold does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to us or to anyone else. Specifically: No analytics or telemetry No tracking of any kind No advertising No user accounts or sign-up No data is sent to any server operated by us or by a third party

docs.heading: Microphone and Speech Recognition
docs.body: Retold uses the microphone only while you are recording. Speech recognition, which turns your recording into text, runs on your iPhone. You can turn either permission off at any time in Settings → Retold.

docs.heading: Data Stored on Your iPhone
docs.body: Retold keeps the following inside its own app storage on your iPhone, protected by iOS Data Protection: Recordings: the audio of each memory you record Transcripts: the words you said, as written down on your iPhone What you confirm: the titles, people, places, periods of life and follow-up questions you choose to file Suggestions for titles, people, places and questions use Apple Intelligence on your iPhone when it is available. They are produced on the device. You can delete a recording that has not been filed. Deleting the app deletes everything Retold stored.

docs.heading: Backups
docs.body: Your library is included in your iPhone's own backups (iCloud Backup or a computer backup), if you have backups turned on. Those backups are managed by Apple and by you; Retold has no access to them.

docs.heading: Exporting
docs.body: Nothing leaves Retold unless you export it. When you export your library, Retold makes a single zip of every recording, every transcript and an index. You choose where it goes from the iOS share sheet. What happens to the file after that is up to you and the service you share it with. Recordings may mention other people, so share with care.

docs.heading: Third-Party Services
docs.body: Retold sends no data to any third-party service, API, or server. Better transcripts (optional). If you choose to download it, Retold fetches a speech model (about 632 MB, on Wi-Fi only) from Hugging Face (huggingface.co), using the open-source WhisperKit library. This is a download of public files: no recordings, transcripts, or identifiers are sent. Once downloaded, the model transcribes your recordings on your iPhone. You can delete it at any time in Retold → Settings → Better transcripts. Hugging Face, like any website, receives the ordinary details of a download request (such as your IP address); see its privacy policy at huggingface.co/privacy.

docs.heading: Children's Privacy
docs.body: Retold is not directed at children under 13 and collects no data from anyone.

docs.heading: Changes to This Policy
docs.body: If this ever changes (for example, if a later version adds sync), this policy will be updated before that version ships, with a new date on this page.

docs.heading: Contact
docs.body: Questions about this policy: privacy@martinapps.dev. For help with the app, see Retold Support.

docs.body: Shortless for iOS · Last updated September 30, 2026

docs.heading: Overview
docs.body: Shortless is a digital wellbeing app for iOS that blocks short-form video feeds (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Snapchat Spotlight) in Safari. It uses a Safari Content Blocker, a Safari Web Extension, and Home Screen widgets. Shortless collects no personal data.

docs.heading: Data Collection
docs.body: Shortless does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. Specifically: No analytics or telemetry No tracking of any kind No cookies No user accounts or sign-up No browsing history is accessed or recorded No data is sent to any server operated by us

docs.heading: How Blocking Works
docs.body: All content blocking happens on your device, using two mechanisms: Safari Content Blocker: Apple's native content-blocking API uses declarative rules, generated on your device from your preferences, to block or hide short-form content before it renders. Safari Web Extension: content scripts watch for short-form content that sites load dynamically (common on YouTube and Instagram) and hide it. Neither mechanism sends any data off your device.

docs.heading: Data Stored on Your Device
docs.body: Shortless keeps a small amount of data on your device, in storage shared between the app and its extensions: Platform preferences: which platforms you have switched on or off Block counter: a daily count of blocked items, for the Time Reclaimed dashboard Onboarding answers: your estimated daily short-form video time and your reduction goal, used to personalize Time Reclaimed Streak: the date your current scroll-free streak began This data never leaves your device. It is not synced to any server, cloud service, or third party, and deleting the app deletes it.

docs.heading: Home Screen Widgets
docs.body: The optional Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your streak, block count, and Time Reclaimed from the same on-device storage. Widgets make no network requests.

docs.heading: Third-Party Services
docs.body: Shortless does not send data to or receive data from any third-party service, API, or server, and makes no network requests of any kind.

docs.heading: Children's Privacy
docs.body: Shortless does not collect data from any user, including children under 13.

docs.heading: Overview
docs.body: Tellfolk helps you record a conversation with someone you care about. It shows one question at a time from a question deck and records the answer with your iPhone's camera and microphone. Tellfolk collects no personal data. Your recordings stay on your iPhone unless you choose to export them. In short: no account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking, and no servers. Tellfolk makes no network requests.

docs.heading: Data Collection
docs.body: Tellfolk does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to us or to anyone else. Specifically: No analytics or telemetry No tracking of any kind No advertising No user accounts or sign-up No data is sent to any server operated by us or by a third party

docs.heading: Camera and Microphone
docs.body: Tellfolk asks for camera and microphone access so it can record video and sound of the person you are interviewing. It uses them only while the recorder is open. You can turn either permission off at any time in Settings → Tellfolk.

docs.heading: Data Stored on Your iPhone
docs.body: Tellfolk keeps the following inside its own app storage on your iPhone: Recordings: the video files of each answer you record Session list: for each session, which question deck you used, when you started, which questions were answered, and which clips belong to each answer A recovery log: a small file that lets Tellfolk find a recording again if the app closes unexpectedly while recording Tellfolk also reads the size and creation date of its own files and the free space on your iPhone, to show how much space recordings use and to warn you when your iPhone is almost full. This information stays on your iPhone. Deleting a session in Tellfolk deletes its recordings. Deleting the app deletes everything Tellfolk stored.

docs.heading: Backups
docs.body: Recordings are included in your iPhone's own backups (iCloud Backup or a computer backup), if you have backups turned on, so you can get them back on a new phone. Those backups are managed by Apple and by you; Tellfolk has no access to them.

docs.heading: Exporting
docs.body: Nothing leaves Tellfolk unless you export it. When you export a session (as one video, or one video per answer): Save to Photos: Tellfolk asks for permission to add to your photo library. It cannot read, change, or delete anything already in your library. Save or share: you choose the destination in the iOS share sheet. Once a file is shared, the app or service you sent it to handles it under its own privacy policy.

docs.heading: The People You Record
docs.body: Please make sure everyone on camera agrees to be recorded. Tellfolk shows a consent card before each session to help with that. You decide what to keep, delete, and share.

docs.heading: Third-Party Services
docs.body: Tellfolk includes no third-party SDKs and does not send data to or receive data from any third-party service, API, or server.

docs.title: Privacy Policy — Wilderness Survival Companion
docs.heading: Wilderness Survival Companion Privacy Policy
docs.desc: The Wilderness Survival Companion privacy policy: how the app handles your information, and your choices. From Martin Apps LLC.
docs.body: Last Updated: September 2026

docs.heading: Overview
docs.body: Wilderness Survival Companion is an offline reference application for backcountry emergencies, hiking preparation, and wilderness skills. All content is based on authoritative sources including FM 21-76, SAS Survival Handbook, CDC, EPA, NWS, and NOAA. No accounts, no servers, no tracking: The app has no backend, so nothing you enter, record, or measure is collected by us or uploaded anywhere. The only data that ever leaves your device is what you deliberately send yourself using the Share or Copy buttons.

docs.heading: Data Collection
docs.body: We do NOT collect, receive, transmit, or share: Personal information Your location Camera images or video Heart-rate or other physiological measurements Device identifiers Usage analytics or crash telemetry Browsing history Some information is saved on your own device so the app is useful between sessions — see On-Device Storage below. That data stays on your device and is never uploaded. Nothing is sent automatically: The app performs all content lookup and all calculations on your device and never sends your data to us — there is no server behind it. Two deliberate exceptions are under your control: if you tap Share or Copy on a position, trip plan, or checklist, your device passes that text to whatever app or contact you pick; and if you use the web version rather than the iPhone or Android app, your browser downloads and updates the app's own files from the site hosting it.

docs.heading: On-Device Storage
docs.body: The application saves the following on your device, so your settings and work persist between sessions: Theme preference (4 adaptive display modes) and Survival Mode setting Unit system preference (imperial/metric) Bookmarked content entries Pace calibration setting Packing checklists and their progress Waypoints you save, including their coordinates Your check-in interval and the emergency plan you write for it — this is free text, so it holds whatever you type into it, which may include names, routes, or phone numbers Trip plans you create Survival scenario progress Any photos you attach to a waypoint (stored in the app's local database) This data stays on your device and is never sent to us or to anyone else. The one place a copy can go is your own device backup: on iPhone, if iCloud Backup is turned on, iOS includes this data in that backup, as it does for most apps. That backup belongs to your Apple account and we have no access to it. The Android app opts out of both cloud backup and device-to-device transfer. You can erase all of it at any time by deleting the app, or item by item within the app.

docs.heading: Location Data
docs.body: Several tools can use your device's GPS location: the compass and waypoint navigator, the daylight and sun-position estimators, the UV exposure estimator, and the check-in timer. Location is requested only while one of these tools is open. A tool that shows a live position keeps it updated while it is on screen, and stops when you leave it. Location is used on your device only, to show your position or perform the calculation you asked for It is never transmitted to us or to any third party — there is no server to receive it Most uses are transient: a reading is displayed, replaced by the next one, and never written to storage Exception: if you deliberately save a waypoint, its coordinates are stored on your device until you delete that waypoint If you tap Share or Copy on your position, you are choosing to hand those coordinates to another app — that is the one way location leaves this app, and only at your direction Location Permission: Location is optional and you may deny it. Some tools then accept manual latitude/longitude entry — the Daylight Estimator, for example — while others, such as the compass position readout, need a real fix and will simply show no position.

docs.heading: Camera
docs.body: The app uses the camera for two features, and only while you are using them: Waypoint photos — when you add a photo to a saved waypoint, your device opens its normal camera or picker sheet. The image you take or choose is saved on your device, in the app's local database, until you delete it. SOS signal beacon — flashes your device's flashlight (torch) in an SOS pattern. On iPhone and Android the app drives the flashlight directly as hardware, which normally involves no camera prompt; where that direct path is unavailable it reaches the torch through the camera interface instead. No image is captured either way. Live camera frames are never recorded: For the SOS beacon, the camera's video track is used only to control the torch — no frames are read, analysed, or recorded, and the camera is released as soon as you leave the feature. The only images this app keeps are the waypoint photos you deliberately attach, and they stay on your device. Heart rate is measured by manually tapping the screen once per heartbeat — it does not use the camera. The reading is an estimate for field awareness only. It is not a medical device and is not written to Apple Health. It is not saved, though if you choose to carry a reading into the triage tool it is passed along for that session.

docs.heading: Motion & Orientation Sensors
docs.body: The step tracker, compass, slope/avalanche inclinometer, and sun tracker read your device's motion and orientation sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer). Your device may ask your permission the first time. These readings are used live on your device to display a heading, angle, or step count. They are not recorded and not transmitted. Your step count is not written to Apple Health.

docs.heading: Permissions
docs.body: Permissions the app MAY request (each optional, each only for the feature named): Location — navigation, sun/daylight, UV, and turnaround tools Camera — waypoint photos and the SOS flashlight beacon Motion & orientation — step tracker, compass, inclinometer, sun tracker Permissions the app explicitly DOES NOT request: Microphone Contacts Photo library Apple Health / HealthKit Push notifications Attaching a photo to a waypoint uses your device's standard photo picker. The app receives only the single image you choose — it never gains access to your photo library.

docs.heading: Third-Party Services
docs.body: Wilderness Survival Companion does not use any third-party services. There are no analytics, advertising, tracking, or data-sharing integrations of any kind, and no third-party SDKs that collect data.

docs.heading: Children's Privacy
docs.body: This is a general-audience educational app. We do not collect any information from any user, including children under 13. The app is COPPA-compliant by design — there is no data collection mechanism.

docs.heading: Changes to This Policy
docs.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be reflected in the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

docs.heading: Contact
docs.body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at: Email: privacy@martinapps.dev Wilderness Survival Companion is published by Martin Apps LLC, an Alabama limited liability company. Company information is available at martinapps.dev. © 2026 Martin Apps LLC. Educational Reference Tool. Return to Martin Apps LLC

docs.title: Wilderness Survival Companion Support
docs.heading: Wilderness Survival Companion Support
docs.desc: Get help with Wilderness Survival Companion, or contact Martin Apps support.
docs.body: Wilderness Survival Companion · Offline survival reference and field tools Wilderness Survival Companion is a survival reference and set of field tools for the North American backcountry. It works with no signal: every reference entry, calculator, and tool is built into the app. In an emergency, call 911 first if you have any way to reach it. The app is a reference, not a substitute for emergency services, search and rescue, or professional medical care. Need help? Email us at support@martinapps.dev and we'll respond within one business day.

docs.heading: Does the app need an internet connection?
docs.body: No. All content and tools are bundled with the app, so everything works in airplane mode or with no signal. There is no account and no sign-in.

docs.heading: Where is my data stored?
docs.body: On your device only. Bookmarks, packing checklists, trip plans, saved waypoints and their photos, your check-in plan, and your display settings are kept locally so they persist between sessions. Nothing is sent to us or to anyone else. A trip plan only leaves your device if you choose to share it yourself. Deleting the app removes all this data.

docs.heading: Why does the app ask for my location?
docs.body: The compass and waypoint navigator, the daylight and sun-position estimators, the UV exposure estimator, and the check-in timer use location. It is optional. If you deny it, the rest of the app keeps working, and some tools let you enter latitude and longitude by hand. Your location never leaves your device.

docs.heading: Why does the app ask for camera access?
docs.body: The camera is used to attach a photo to a saved waypoint, and the flashlight is used by the SOS signal beacon. Camera access is optional; you can deny it and use everything else.

docs.heading: Where does the survival content come from?
docs.body: Every reference entry and calculator traces to a published source, including U.S. Army Field Manual FM 21-76, the SAS Survival Handbook, NOLS, the CDC, the EPA, and the National Weather Service / NOAA. Medical content follows the MARCH ordering used in tactical and wilderness first aid, and does not include medication dosages.

docs.heading: Can I use the plant entries to decide what is safe to eat?
docs.body: Not on the app alone. Each edible-plant entry lists its toxic lookalikes and how to tell them apart, but misidentifying a plant can be fatal. If you are not certain, do not eat it.

docs.heading: I found an error in an entry. How do I report it?
docs.body: Please email support@martinapps.dev with the entry name and what looks wrong. Accuracy reports are treated as the highest priority.

docs.heading: How do I make the screen easier to read outdoors or at night?
docs.body: Open Settings and choose one of the four display modes: High Noon for bright sunlight, Civil Twilight for everyday use, Deep Night for dark conditions, and Tactical Red to help preserve your night vision.

docs.heading: Who took the photos in the app?
docs.body: Reference photos come from Wikimedia Commons and U.S. government sources. From version 1.8, each photo shows its author and licence, and the full source and licence details are under Settings → Photo Credits.

docs.heading: Does the app cost anything?
docs.body: No. There are no in-app purchases, no ads, no analytics, and no third-party tracking.

docs.heading: Is the app affiliated with any government or rescue agency?
docs.body: No. Wilderness Survival Companion is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any government, military, or search-and-rescue agency. Sources are cited for accuracy, not to imply endorsement.

docs.body: For support inquiries, feedback, or to report an issue: Email: support@martinapps.dev Privacy questions: privacy@martinapps.dev For privacy details, see our Privacy Policy. The app is available on the App Store. © 2026 Martin Apps LLC. Wilderness Survival Companion is a reference tool. It is not a substitute for professional training, search-and-rescue services, or emergency medical care.
